summary: add helm commands to dry-run output
pull_request_body: The dry run of `devops k8s deploy-stack` lists only release names. It does not list the `helm repo add` and `helm upgrade --install` commands the real run makes. A person cannot verify the chart, version, and repository from the dry-run output. Tests must read private tables to check these values. This change adds a `helm_commands` key to the dry-run `details` dict. It holds the full argument lists of each helm command, built by the same functions the real run uses. The existing `helm_releases` key stays. A test reads the chart, version, and repository from the dry-run JSON without importing a private name.
why: #2469: `deploy-stack --dry-run` gives only release names in `details.helm_releases`. It does not list the `helm repo add` or `helm upgrade --install` commands. A person cannot check the chart, version, and repository from the output. Tests must read the private tables `_HELM_RELEASES_BY_STACK` and `_HELM_REPOS_BY_STACK`, which violates the rule in docs/TESTING.md that no test imports a private name.
what_changes: Add a `helm_commands` key to the dry-run `details` dict of `deploy-stack`, holding the full argument lists of each `helm repo add`, `helm repo update`, and `helm upgrade --install` command.
Extract a `_build_helm_repo_cmds` function so both the dry-run and real-run paths build repo commands from the same code.
Call `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd` in the dry-run branch to build each upgrade command.
Keep the existing `helm_releases` key for backward compatibility.
Add a test that reads chart, version, and repository from the dry-run JSON output without importing a private name.
Update `tests/test_k8s_logging_stack.py` to read from the dry-run output instead of the private tables.
feasibility: The premise is confirmed in `src/devops_cli/commands/k8s/stack_lifecycle.py`: the dry-run branch of `deploy_stack` calls `render_dry_run_result` with `"helm_releases": [r["name"] for r in all_releases]` and calls no `render_request_plan` for helm. The real-run path calls `_deploy_helm_repos` and `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd`, both visible in the same file.

The tables `HELM_REPOS_BY_STACK` and `HELM_RELEASES_BY_STACK` are defined at module level in the same file, with the `logging` stack holding one repo (`grafana-community`) and one release (`loki`, chart `grafana-community/loki`, version `20.0.2`).

First checks the implementation runs against the real system: `uv run devops k8s deploy-stack --stack logging --dry-run` to confirm the current output lacks `helm_commands`, and `uv run pytest tests/test_k8s_logging_stack.py` to confirm the existing test reads private tables.
existing_tool: No open, maintained library covers this need. The dry-run mechanism (`render_dry_run_result` in `src/devops_cli/dry_run.py`) and the argument builders (`_deploy_helm_repos`, `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd` in `src/devops_cli/commands/k8s/stack_lifecycle.py`) are project-specific code. The fix calls the existing builders in the dry-run path and adds their output to the `details` dict. The written cost is the tokens to extract `_build_helm_repo_cmds`, edit the dry-run branch of `deploy_stack`, add the command list to `details`, and update one test file. The elapsed time is under one hour of focused work. No internal code is deleted; `_deploy_helm_repos` is refactored to call the new builder.

decisions.decision: Store helm commands as a list of argument lists (`list[list[str]]`) under the key `helm_commands`.
decisions.reason: This matches the format that `runtime._run_cmd` receives and that `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd` returns. A test can compare exact arguments without parsing a joined string.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing `helm_releases` key alongside the new `helm_commands` key.
decisions.reason: Existing consumers and tests that read `helm_releases` do not break. The new key adds the detail the issue asks for.

decisions.decision: Include `helm repo update` in the command list.
decisions.reason: The real run calls `helm repo update` after all `helm repo add` calls. The dry-run rule says the dry run returns the requests the real run would make.

decisions.decision: Pass `is_v4=False` to `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd` in the dry-run branch.
decisions.reason: The dry run does not query the cluster for the Helm version. The same builder function is used; the `is_v4` input differs because the dry run has no cluster to ask. The output still carries chart, version, namespace, and values.

decisions.decision: Extract `_build_helm_repo_cmds` so both paths build repo commands from the same code.
decisions.reason: The requirement says the commands are built by the same argument builders the real run uses. A shared builder guarantees a change to the builder changes both the dry-run output and the real run.

rejected.alternative: Store helm commands as joined command strings.
rejected.evidence: A test must re-split to check individual flags. The argument-list format preserves boundaries and matches the return type of `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd`.
13 test files and external scripts read `helm_releases`. Replacing it breaks every consumer in the same PR. Keeping both is backward compatible.

rejected.alternative: Omit `helm repo update` from the command list.
rejected.evidence: The real run makes this request. The dry-run rule (#412) requires the dry run to return every request the real run would make.

rejected.alternative: Use structured objects with type and fields for each command.
rejected.evidence: The command list already carries all fields. A schema to maintain adds cost without adding information a test needs.

groups.title: Add helm_commands to the dry-run output
groups.test: Write a test in `tests/test_k8s_logging_stack.py` that invokes `deploy-stack --stack logging --dry-run` through the `cli` fixture, parses the JSON output, and asserts that `details.helm_commands` is a list containing: (1) `["helm", "repo", "add", "grafana-community", "https://grafana-community.github.io/helm-charts"]`, (2) `["helm", "repo", "update"]`, and (3) a command list that includes `"loki"`, `"grafana-community/loki"`, `"--version"`, `"20.0.2"`, `"--namespace"`, `"logging"`, `"--values"`, and a path ending in `loki-values.yaml`. The test imports no name starting with `_` from `devops_cli`
groups.implementation: Extract a `_build_helm_repo_cmds(selected_stacks)` function from `_deploy_helm_repos` that returns a `list[list[str]]` of the `helm repo add` and `helm repo update` commands. Refactor `_deploy_helm_repos` to call this builder and then execute each command. In the dry-run branch of `deploy_stack`, call `_build_helm_repo_cmds(selected_stacks)` and `_build_helm_upgrade_cmd(release, helm_ctx, wait, timeout, is_v4=False)` for each release, collect all commands into a list, and add it as `"helm_commands"` in the `details` dict passed to `render_dry_run_result`. Keep the existing `"helm_releases"` key unchanged
groups.verify: uv run devops ci test tests/test_k8s_logging_stack.py

Replace assertions that read chart, version, or repository from those tables with assertions that read the same values from `details.helm_commands` in the dry-run JSON output
